title: 第七百九十九章 谈谈第七百九十八章 原来是你
slug: 仙魂斗战第八百零四章闹事生非
lines: 冯斗此时不由得笑道：“现在是否可以好好地谈谈呢？”
可是对方摆明没有打算与冯斗一谈，他大骂道：“有什么好谈的呢？给老子去死！”
就在此时的冯斗突然之间发觉对方居然想着要自爆将冯斗击杀了，冯斗心里想：真的是疯子一个，既然如此，那就不要怪我不客气了，老子让你见识一下什么是怪物啦！
冯斗一脚就已经将对方直接踢了出去，到底是什么情况呢？
那个人原地爆炸了，就在此时，冯斗感受到全身一下子就已经非常之痛快的感觉，瞬间他就已经感受到灵气全部回来了，他感受到眼前的强光是这样耀眼的，他刚刚眯上眼睛，当他再次睁开时，他能够清晰到这里是一个全新的地方，甚至他都不曾来过的。
此时就只有他一个人到来的，然而他睁开眼睛第一眼就是看到了一个巨大的石碑，上面刻画着四个字“无我亦无”。
冯斗看到这四个大字时，他的心里不由得一惊，他心里想：这里不会就是第三关吧？这里又是什么考验呢？
就在此时，一个声音出现了，“想不到，你居然又是第一人，看来你的实力真实不错啦！”
这个人也是算得上冯斗的老熟人了，这个人正是之前的莫贵，冯斗笑道：“莫老哥，你的速度也不错哦！居然那么快就已经完成了，这里就是第三关吗？”
莫贵听到这一句话时，他微笑道：“不错的！这里就是第三关，怎么啦？”
“那么这关考什么呢？”
“这个算得上考智力啦！”
“考什么智力呢？”
“棋艺！”
冯斗听到这一番话时，他彻底地蒙圈了，毕竟这个时候，棋艺对于冯斗来说，绝对是一个笑话了，他冯斗算得上样样精通的奇才，然而这个时候却是让他相当泪目的事情，那就是他对于棋艺来说，真的算得上十窍开了九窍，一窍不通啦！
这样一来就让冯斗彻底地蒙圈了，因为这个真的算得上击中了冯斗的软肋了，他真的想要自杀的感受都已经有了，他心里想：真的什么鬼啊？居然要来考什么棋艺，这个无疑是给到我上眼药啦！这一下子要怎么办呢？现在也没有什么好办法了，只能见步行步了，不然一切都已经是白搭了，就看看莫贵怎么样了，我就不相信只是表面上那么简单的下一盘棋而已。
冯斗笑道：“不会只是下盘棋而已吧？”
莫贵听到这一番话时，他笑道：“当然啦！如果只是下盘棋，肯定有不少人愿意一试啦！”
冯斗听到之后，他笑道：“这当中也是有不少猫腻啦？”
莫贵微微点点头道：“当然啦！传说之中，当年的黄泉圣君得到了天下棋盘，传说之中，黄泉圣君得到了棋圣的所有棋谱，然而在这里设下了耗尽棋圣一生心血的天下棋牌，谁能够破得了这个天下棋牌就可以完成这第三关啦！”
冯斗听到这一番话时，瞬间就已经找到了当中的猫腻，那就是那么多人已经破掉了这个棋盘才完成的，那样都已经成功让人夺得黄泉阴阳眼的，这个棋盘应该早就被人破掉啦！
冯斗自然能够明白当中的东西，他不会那么轻易就已经是完成的，可是他心里也算得上有一定怀疑了，他连忙说：“其实按照常理来说，我不应该怀疑你的为人，不过这一切之中有一个最大的漏洞，那就是你所说的这个天下棋牌了，毕竟以前并不是从来没有人夺得这个黄泉阴阳眼，那就代表着这个天下棋牌必定已经有人破过，这样来说就是这个天下棋牌现在就不存在了，谈何是这第三关呢？”
莫贵听到冯斗的话时，非但没有生气，反而是相当高兴的，他笑道：“其实你有这样的想法是完全正常的，我就不用说其他的，这个天下棋盘一共被人破了七次，至于它究竟有几次的上限呢？不过我可以告诉你一个不为人知的秘密，这个天下棋盘并不是简单的一个惨谱啦！而是一个惨谱集，涵盖了天下所有残局，所以说就算你破了一个残局，他马上就有另外一个残局替上，根本就不打算没有残局可以用的状态。”
冯斗听到这一番话时，也是一下子明白了，其实冯斗也是有所猜测的，只不过现在得到了莫贵的话之后，他也是相当肯定了，其实也是在情理之中，也是最为之而最可能的结果。
冯斗笑道：“莫老哥，你是不是曾经试过呢？”
莫贵听到冯斗的话时，他脸上不由得露出一副尴尬的表情，他笑道：“好汉不提当年勇。”
冯斗一听这番话时，他瞬间就已经是猜出了这当中肯定有不少的弯弯绕绕，他说：“莫老哥，你这里肯定有故事哦！说说嘛！”

这一下子让莫贵变得相当不好意思了，他尴尬道：“说起这个就是相当尴尬的，我上次前来这里就是到了这一关，其实来说，却是成为了一个鸡肋的存在，我根本就不懂得任何的棋艺，来到这里之后，也是白白地浪费了机会，结果我就已经止步于这关，这个也是三百年之前的事情啦！所以这三百年之内，我以棋会友也是算得上足够做到棋艺高超啦！我现在已经是有四成的可能胜过这一关，所以这次先由我来吧！也算得上给你来个例子，让你在一旁好好地观摩一番！”
冯斗此时真的是心中有苦说不出来的，毕竟现在的他对于棋艺算得上一窍不通的，就算是让他抄功课，他都没有把握能够完成的，他不由得露出了苦笑啦！
冯斗也是第一次感受到自己实在有心无力的状态，真的是有力使不出来的那种憋屈感一下子涌了上来，真的让他瞬间感受到自己还是那么弱小的，真的应了那一句话，书到用时方恨少啦！
冯斗不由得心里默默地问自己为何平时自己不狩猎一下棋艺方面了，不然也不会起到这样尴尬啦！
不过有莫贵在场的情况下，他也还可以观摩一番，反正这里没有限制时间，他打算先来一波临阵磨枪的准备，先借助其他人闯关时的棋艺进而偷师一下，这样就可以起到不错的作用啦！
这样做也是目前最为之有效的办法啦！真的是马死落地行啦！

Feng Dou couldn't help but smile at this time: "Can we have a good talk now?"
But the other party made it clear that he had no intention of talking to Feng Dou, and he cursed: "What's there to talk about? Go to hell!"
At this moment, Feng Dou suddenly realized that the other party was actually planning to blow himself up and killed Feng Dou. Feng Dou thought to himself: He is really a lunatic. In this case, don't blame me for being rude. I want you to see what a monster is!
Feng Dou had already kicked the opponent out with one kick. What was going on?
The man exploded on the spot. At this moment, Feng Dou felt a very pleasant feeling all over his body. In an instant, he felt all the spiritual energy coming back. He felt that the bright light in front of him was so dazzling. He just squinted his eyes. When he opened them again, he could clearly realize that this was a brand new place, one that he had never even been to.
He was the only one who arrived at this time, but the first thing he saw when he opened his eyes was a huge stone tablet with the four words "No self and no one" engraved on it.
When Feng Dou saw these four big characters, he couldn't help but be shocked. He thought to himself: Could this be the third level? What is the test here?
At this moment, a voice appeared, "Unexpectedly, you are actually the first person again. It seems that your strength is really good!"
This person can also be regarded as an old acquaintance of Feng Dou. This person is the former Mo Gui. Feng Dou smiled and said: "Brother Mo, your speed is not bad! You have completed it so quickly. Is this the third level?"
When Mo Gui heard this, he smiled and said, "Not bad! This is the third level. What's wrong?"
"Then what's the test?"
"This is considered a test of intelligence!"
"What is the intelligence test?"
"Chess skills!"
When Feng Dou heard these words, he was completely confused. After all, chess was definitely a joke to Feng Dou at this time. He, Feng Dou, was considered a prodigy who was proficient in everything. However, at this time, something that made him quite tearful was that he really had nine out of ten knowledge about chess, and he knew nothing!
This completely confused Feng Dou, because this really hit Feng Dou's weakness. He already felt like he really wanted to commit suicide. He thought to himself: What the hell is going on? I'm actually going to take a chess test. This is undoubtedly an eyesore for me! What should we do now? There is no good solution now. We can only keep walking, otherwise everything will be in vain. Just look at how Mo Gui is doing. I don't believe that it is just a simple game of chess on the surface.
Feng Dou smiled and said, "It's not just a game of chess, is it?"
When Mo Gui heard this, he smiled and said: "Of course! If it's just a game of chess, there will definitely be many people willing to give it a try!"
After Feng Dou heard this, he smiled and said: "There are a lot of tricks in this?"
Mo Gui nodded slightly and said: "Of course! According to the legend, Saint Lord Huangquan obtained the world chess board. According to the legend, Saint Lord Huangquan obtained all the chess records of the chess saint. However, a world chess card that consumed the chess saint's life was set up here. Whoever can break this world chess card can complete the third level!"
When Feng Dou heard these words, he immediately found out the trick, that is, so many people had already broken the chessboard to complete it. If they had already succeeded in getting the Yin and Yang Eyes of Huangquan, this chessboard should have been broken long ago!
Feng Dou could naturally understand what was in it. He would not complete it so easily, but he had some doubts in his heart. He quickly said: "In fact, according to common sense, I shouldn't doubt your character, but there is one biggest loophole in all this. That is the world chess and card you are talking about. After all, no one has ever won the Yin and Yang Eye of Huangquan before, which means that someone must have broken this world chess and card. In this way, this world chess and card no longer exists. What is the third level? "
When Mo Gui heard Feng Dou's words, instead of being angry, he was quite happy. He smiled and said: "Actually, it's completely normal for you to have such thoughts. I don't need to say anything else. This world chessboard has been broken seven times in total. As for the upper limit of how many times it has? But I can tell You have a little-known secret, this world chessboard is not just a tragic game! It is a collection of tragic games, covering all the endings in the world, so even if you break one ending, he will immediately have another ending to take his place, and there is no intention of leaving any endings available. "
When Feng Dou heard these words, he suddenly understood. In fact, Feng Dou had also made a guess, but now after receiving Mo Gui's words, he was quite sure. In fact, it was reasonable and the most likely result.
Feng Dou smiled and said, "Brother Mo, have you tried it before?"
When Mo Gui heard Feng Dou's words, he couldn't help showing an embarrassed expression on his face. He smiled and said: "A good man does not mention his bravery."
When Feng Dou heard these words, he instantly guessed that there must be a lot of twists and turns. He said, "Brother Mo, you must have a story here! Tell me!"
This suddenly made Mo Gui feel quite embarrassed. He said awkwardly: "It's quite embarrassing to talk about this. The last time I came here was at this level. In fact, I became a worthless existence. I didn't know any chess skills at all. After coming here, I wasted the opportunity. As a result, I I have stopped at this level, and this happened three hundred years ago! So within the past three hundred years, I have been able to achieve a good level of chess! I now have a 40% chance of beating this level, so let me give you an example this time, so you can watch it carefully!"
Feng Dou really couldn't express the pain in his heart at this time. After all, he knew nothing about chess now. Even if he was asked to copy his homework, he was not sure he could complete it. He couldn't help but show a bitter smile!
It was also the first time that Feng Dou felt that he was really powerless. The feeling of suffocation that he really couldn't control suddenly came up. It really made him instantly feel that he was still so weak. If he really complied with those words, he would feel less regretful when the book comes to use!
Feng Dou couldn't help but silently ask himself why he didn't usually explore chess skills, otherwise he wouldn't be so embarrassed!
However, with Mo Gui present, he can also observe and learn. There is no time limit here anyway. He plans to make some preparations to sharpen his skills before the battle. He will first use the chess skills of others to break through the level and then steal them. This can play a good role!
This is also the most effective method currently! It’s really a matter of time and again!
